user.title: Sign in to E.ON Next
user.description: Your password is stored so the integration can sign in again when its weekly refresh token expires. It is never logged.

data_description.backfill_days: Imported once, on first setup, in 7-day chunks. It resumes if Home Assistant restarts part-way through.

meter.title: Choose a meter
meter.description: Your account has more than one electricity meter. Add the integration again to import another.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to E.ON Next again
reauth_confirm.description: E.ON Next rejected the stored password for {email}.

error.invalid_auth: E.ON Next rejected the email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach E.ON Next. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This meter is already set up.
abort.no_meters: No electricity import meters were found on this account.

init.title: Off-peak windows
init.description: Local (UK) time ranges such as 00:00-07:00, one per line. Ranges may cross midnight and must start and end on the hour or half-hour. Half-hours outside every window count as peak. Changes apply to hours re-imported from now on; use the backfill action to reclassify older history.

backfill.name: Backfill
backfill.description: Re-import half-hourly consumption for a range of dates, then carry any change in the running totals forward to later hours.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last day to re-import, inclusive (UK local).

config_entry_id.name: Meter
config_entry_id.description: Only re-import this meter. Defaults to every configured meter.
